memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow‑up of sciatica and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports burning pain radiating from left lower buttock to foot, worse on sitting, and mild itchy plaques on elbows and knees.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.6 (obese). Straight leg raise positive at 45° left. Skin shows well‑demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale on extensor surfaces.
IMPRESSION: Sciatica likely L4‑5 disc irritation; chronic plaque psoriasis uncontrolled. BMI obese – advise reduced calorie intake and daily walking. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, LFT, CBC, creatinine, MRI lumbar spine and X‑ray lumbar spine.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; topical clobetasol 0.05% cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg daily. Return if new numbness, weakness, bowel/bladder change, fever >39°C, or worsening skin lesions.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Pregabalin 75 mg twice daily
Diclofenac sodium 50 mg twice daily after food
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg once daily
Clobetasol 0.05% cream apply twice daily to affected areas
Calcipotriol ointment apply once daily to affected areas
Methotrexate 7.5 mg orally once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg orally once daily

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: Left leg pain at 45° elevation, right leg negative. Suggestive of lumbar radiculopathy.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: Disc protrusion at L4‑5 indenting the left traversing nerve root, no canal stenosis.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: X‑ray lumbar spine: Mild degenerative changes at L4‑5, disc space preserved.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting glucose 92 mg/dL (70‑99). Total cholesterol 198 mg/dL (<200 desirable), LDL 118 mg/dL (<100 optimal), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40 male), triglycerides 148 mg/dL (<150). ALT 28 U/L (7‑56), AST 26 U/L (10‑40), ALP 78 U/L (40‑129), GGT 32 U/L (0‑51). Hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL (13‑17), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4‑10), Platelets 210 x10^9/L (150‑400). Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of sciatica and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Pain decreased to occasional ache, able to walk longer; topical steroids reduced plaque thickness but mild residual scaling.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/82 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 27.3 (obese). Straight leg raise now negative. Skin shows faint pink patches on elbows, no active scaling.
IMPRESSION: Sciatica improving; psoriasis partially responsive to topicals. Methotrexate may need liver monitoring. BMI obese – reinforce diet and activity advice.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, reduce diclofenac to 25 mg BD after food due to gastric discomfort, maintain methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Keep topical clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg daily. Return if pain worsens, new weakness, fever, or skin flare.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review, vaccine update.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Sciatica asymptomatic; psoriasis plaques mild, no new lesions.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 76 kg, BMI 26.9 (overweight). No neurological deficit. Skin shows faint erythema on knees, no scale.
IMPRESSION: Sciatica resolved; psoriasis mild. BMI overweight – advise continued activity. Annual metabolic screen ordered.
ARRANGEMENTS: Influenza vaccine given today 02‑Oct‑2025. Continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 25 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Keep topical clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg daily. Return if pain returns, new skin lesions, fever >39°C, or unexplained bruising.
